invitations_live_unique.name: invitations_live_unique
invitations_live_unique.where: "invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "invitations"."revoked_at" is null and "invitations"."purpose" = 'invite'

invitations_invite_shape_check.name: invitations_invite_shape_check
invitations_invite_shape_check.value: ("invitations"."purpose" = 'invite') = ("invitations"."role" is not null and "invitations"."comp_id" is not null)

assignments_live_unique.name: assignments_live_unique
assignments_live_unique.where: revoked_at is null and team_id is not null

assignments_live_no_team_unique.name: assignments_live_no_team_unique
assignments_live_no_team_unique.where: revoked_at is null and team_id is null

assignments_window_check.name: assignments_window_check
assignments_window_check.value: "assignments"."ends_at" is null or ("assignments"."starts_at" is not null and "assignments"."ends_at" > "assignments"."starts_at")

assignments_progress_check.name: assignments_progress_check
assignments_progress_check.value: "assignments"."completed_at" is null or "assignments"."acknowledged_at" is not null
